title: Glitches of vertical pixel offsets around edges of UI panels
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.3.stable.official 77dcf97d8

### System information

Windows 11 (Version 10.0.22631 Build 22631) - Godot v4.3.stable.official - Vulkan 1.4.303 (Forward Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H, 3301 Mhz, 6 Core(s), 12 Logical Processor(s)

### Issue description

In the Godot Editor, there are glitches in the form of _single-pixel vertical offsets_ around edges of some UI panels (like the Scene tab) and some UI widgets (like the Filter input inside the Scene tab).

Not all panels & widgets have the glitch. Some always have it, and some only have it when resizing their parent panel. I'll share several examples of each below.

Notice the left edge of an open scene's tab:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1b97d73c-a5ca-4e89-b341-d363c6f2636f)

Notice the edges where the panels on the left (Scene panel) & right (Script Editor panel) meet:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50e410b8-1bd0-4690-bef4-bda87eeae7ab)

Notice the left edge of the Filter input in the Scene tab:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/862a594a-4c0b-47f6-994f-c83b582150f5)

This is how the "glitch" behaves when resizing the panels. Also in this video you can see how rulers display the same glitching behavior while resizing:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/29ffc4f3-cc3a-4afb-808d-e10af72647d7

Just realized that a running game is also susceptible to the same issue. This is the "Dodge the Creeps!" demo game running. Notice this time there are also horizontal glitches at the top side of the title font, and vertical glitches at each side of the "Start" button:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f28a1c47-5787-49f0-b022-cf29b9b676eb)

### Steps to reproduce

Open any project in the Godot version specified above.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any new empty project has the issue.
